question: Three taps A, B and C can fill a tank in 12,25 and 20 hours respectively. If a is open all the time and B and C are open for one hour each alternately, the tank will be full in :
explanation:
🔖Hints: Answer not given.
A+B s 1 hour work = ( 1/12 + 1/15) = 3/20
A+C s hours work = ( 1/12 + 1/20) = 2/15
Part filled in 2 hrs = ( 3/20 + 2/15) = 17/60
part filled 6 hrs = (3× 17/60) = 17/20
Remaining part = ( 1 - 17/20) = 3/20
Now, it is the turn of A and B and 3/20 part is filled by A and B in 1 hour
Total time taken to fill the tank = ( 6+1) = 7 hrs

question: In each of the following questions, count the number of triangles and squares in the given figure.
explanation:
🔖A Collection of 16 coins,each with a face value of either 10 paisa or 25 paisa, has a total face value of Tk. 2.35 How many of the coins have a face value of 25 paisa?
We can let the number of 10-paisa coins = d and the number of 25-paisa coins = q. We are given that there are 16 total coins; thus, d + q = 16.
We are also given that the total face value isTk.2.35, thus:
0.1d + 0.25q = 2.35
10d + 25q = 235
Isolating d in our first equation, we have d = 16 - q. We can substitute 16 - q for d in our second equation and we have:
10(16 - q) + 25q = 235
160 - 10q + 25q = 235
15q = 75
q = 5
There are 5 coins with a face value of 25 paisa.
subject: গাণিতিক যুক্তি
